recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16155 unless a future Patient Administration decision changes the meaning of Patient.managingOrganization or its organization search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-16155 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request for STU3 asking that the Patient organization search parameter description be updated to match Patient.managingOrganization's custodian-of-record meaning.
initial_application: The historical application commit 8fb31595e9 changed the old spreadsheet search parameter description from the organization where the person is a patient to the organization that is the custodian of the patient record. The 2021 source refactor in 33b409a4b6 preserved that wording in the current XML sources.
additional_context: Patient is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines Patient-organization with path and expression Patient.managingOrganization and a custodian description, while Patient.managingOrganization itself has matching custodian short and definition text. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative Patient search parameter and element definition already implement the published Jira decision.
